models_evaluated: ROAD2H TMR-based ABA+G clinical decision support prototype (GOLD 2017 COPD guideline)

links.outcome: Pulmonologists' agreement with CDSS assessments and reception of explainable argumentation
links.effect: Pulmonologists agreed 97% with symptom severity assessment and 98% with one of the proposed care plans; comments favourable on explainable argumentation, with suggestion to customise explanation level by expertise.
links.quote: Comments were favourable on the principles of explainable argumentation; inclusion of additional co-morbidities was suggested in the future along with customisation of the level of explanation with expertise.

unlisted_practices: Using ontology-based computable guidelines with assumptions-based argumentation to manage co-morbidity conflicts in decision support
Integrating CDS with EHR via HL7 FHIR and CDS Hooks microservices

screen.reason: Evaluates a prototype explainable CDSS based on computable guidelines and argumentation theory using 20 simulated cases with clinicians, but evaluates the system itself rather than comparing deployment practices.
